name: Estee Lauder Companies Inc. (The)
base_source: median_of_last_3_fy_oe_per_share (FY2024 $3.09, FY2025 $1.02, FY2026 $2.76; latest FY ended 2026-06-30 is also the TTM — Q1 FY2027 not yet filed, so no TTM override)
moat_justification: Prestige brand portfolio (La Mer, MAC, Le Labo, Estée Lauder) with 75.5% gross margin and China share gains in FY2026, but eroding: three years of revenue decline FY23-25, repeated acquired-brand impairments (Dr.Jart+, Too Faced, Tom Ford), L'Oréal/local-brand pressure, department-store and travel-retail channel decay.
fragility_flags: OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Real prestige-brand moat (5/10) in a genuine early turnaround, but at $99.13 the price is 36x trough-normalized owner's earnings of $2.76/share — weighted IV@15% is $23.50 (IRR 5.5%, Tier D); it only clears the 15% hurdle at ~$23.50, or ~$19 with a margin of safety.
